description: CSSP question graph. Each question links to its concepts with strength 1, each concept to its chapter, and every pair of questions to each other.

rules.questionToQuestion: 0.6 + 0.2 x concept overlap if they share a concept, else 0.25 if same chapter, else 0; plus 0.2 x wording similarity; clamped to 0.01..1
rules.similarityLayout: Flat upper triangle: the pair (i, j) with i < j is at i*n - i*(i+1)/2 + (j - i - 1), where n is the number of questionIds.
